map.调味汁比例计算器，选择酱汁类型与基准勺数自动计算各调料用量，复刻标准味型、稳定出: Sauce Ratio Calculator: choose the sauce type and the base number of spoons and the tool computes each seasoning amount, reproducing a standard flavour profile and stabilising output quality.
map.调糖醋汁、照烧汁时按固定比例（如糖:醋:酱油 ≈ 1:1:0.5）批量换算，保证: When mixing sweet and sour sauce or teriyaki sauce, convert in batches at a fixed ratio (for example sugar:vinegar:soy sauce ≈ 1:1:0.5) so the flavour is identical every time instead of relying on feel.
map.凉拌菜按总量反推盐、醋、油、辣的用量，尤其多人份或外卖标准化出品时减少误差。: For cold dressed dishes, work backwards from the total batch size to the salt, vinegar, oil and chilli amounts, which cuts error a lot for large batches or standardised takeaway output.
map.减盐减糖版调味汁：按比例等幅下调并微调酸/鲜平衡，记录配方便于复刻。: Reduced-salt, reduced-sugar sauce: scale every ingredient down by the same ratio, fine-tune the acid and savoury balance, and record the formula so it can be reproduced.
map.糖醋汁比例换算: Sweet and sour sauce ratio conversion
map.：通用糖醋汁 糖:醋:生抽:水 ≈ 2:2:1:1（加少许淀粉勾芡）；若需总汁: A general sweet and sour sauce uses sugar:vinegar:light soy sauce:water ≈ 2:2:1:1 (with a little starch to thicken); for 200 ml of total sauce that is about 57 ml each of sugar and vinegar and about 28 ml each of soy sauce and water, adjusted to taste.
map.比例是按体积还是重量？: Is the ratio by volume or by weight?
map.家常液体调料多按体积（勺/毫升）近似，固体（糖、盐）按重量更准；本工具以体积比例: Household liquid seasonings are usually measured by volume (spoons/millilitres) while solids (sugar, salt) are more accurate by weight; this tool converts mainly by volume ratio, so adjust it to the measuring tools you have.
map.鱼香汁和糖醋汁区别？: What is the difference between yuxiang sauce and sweet and sour sauce?
map.鱼香汁在糖醋基础上加泡椒/豆瓣酱、姜葱蒜成咸甜酸辣复合味；糖醋汁偏纯酸甜，比例与: Yuxiang sauce adds pickled chilli, doubanjiang, ginger, spring onion and garlic to the sweet and sour base for a salty-sweet-sour-spicy profile; sweet and sour sauce leans towards pure sweet and sour, so the ratios and the flavour focus differ.
map.为什么同比例有时偏咸？: Why does the same ratio sometimes taste too salty?
map.不同品牌酱油盐度、醋的酸度差异大，按比例调好后务必尝味微调，工具比例作起点而非绝: Salt content of soy sauce and acidity of vinegar vary a lot between brands, so always taste and fine-tune after scaling; treat the tool's ratio as a starting point, not an absolute standard.
